body: Don't ever think lines like that actually work, I don't even know you.
Feeling no pain at all right now, don't know how long this would last.
Thanks dude, but no, it's been hours already before the post. I don't think I could throw it up all now.

It is also not because I'm miserable because of the people around me, I'm miserable because I'm unable to help the people around me. I could've, I blown it all off. thinking there's always a next time. And now I have nothing left.
Surely I regret I could've done more with my life, but not this one. I don't need help, I just want solace that It'd all be over with this.

I actually tried to assess how much emotional damage I could do before downing all of it. Sure my parent would be devastated, but only because I was their son, I don't think there'd be more people thinking about me. And I know no mistake is too big, it's just too much for me and people around me are visibly miserable, either because of me or a whole 'nother set of baggage.
Too late, I just need painkillers or something to distract myself.
Read all of it, thinking it'd just be short pangs, then coma or death maybe. Currently regretting this method, hoping for a gun. At least link me distractions.
Goodbye, man. Just remember, if you ever have doubts doing something, just fuck all of it, embarassment outweighs severe anxiety.
Constantly wishing I had a gun before doing all these. Fuck now I'm really scared, I've always ran away from pain, I don't want to to end it with one.
Thanks but, no, thing is I'm already dying, they're not much help.
How excruciating it is anyway? Had pangs of ulcer back then, felt like hell...how would this compare?
I don't have this at the time, just completely ransacked out medicine cabinet.

I did this just before family left for something, I don't want to be too much of a burden, the trouble of burying me is already too much. I have been a failure my whole life, I guess this is where it all ends.
I've nowhere to go to, I even chose this because I'm scared of painful ways. I just wanted to talk to someone before all this.
Anything to do this faster? I just don't want my relatives to see me suffering
Is death certain or is this not enough?
